transport_evidence.maker_only_why: both recovered rows are fill-or-kill, i.e. TAKER orders. The MOC maker path is the one the live modules were written against, but a venue-ACCEPTED MOC order is not in the recovered evidence.
transport_evidence.labels: 'PROVEN' here means only that this socket has carried an accepted order. It does not extend to the size or the maker semantics this canary would use; those are the two things the canary would newly establish.
